flag_disposition: Source literal content is scalar algorithm constants and readable documentation only; no encoded/fitted table or external/process access. Entire source reviewed.
implementation: Plain PyTorch/cuBLAS/cuSOLVER/ATen flash attention; no custom Triton/native kernel.
current_input_fitting: Fresh labels/counts, class moments, LDA/QDA Fisher metric, compression/landmarks/weights, FITC-Woodbury preconditioner, zero-origin PCG recurrence and current scores recomputed inside captured run; all caller inputs copied into owned static clones each call.
cache_ownership: _GRAPHS retains graph/static inputs/output; _C retains only scalar/identity/zero/one/index tensors and _ST retains streams. Captured intermediates use retained graph-private pools; outputs cloned.
work: Current full fit executes at every replay. Side streams explicitly branch/join before dependent operations. Fixed metric/compression/PCG work; first-call compilation/capture/64 replays stay in foreign warmup.
truth: Only supplied train_y gives truth. No query truth, files/network, caller/parent/scorer/timer introspection, offline prior or learned warmup state reused.
published_scope: Official three-run median; independent reviewer reproduction supplies evidence, not a permanent source-ban or mandatory additional published batch. Optional energy assessed separately from score.

fresh_reviewer_outcome.decision: merge exact submitted source; promote reviewer medians if faster than current record

source_review_status: Full source/rules/stream ownership, reset, bounds, math, author arithmetic and upstream provenance reviewed; no static blocker.
linear_algebra: Standard-form Woodbury FITC and LDA low-rank inverse identities independently checked in8CPU FP64 controls (max relativeerror~2.2e-16). Low-precision products are numerical changes and actual predictions remain subject to canonical qualification. See linear-algebra-audit.json.
precision: TF32 and fp16 reduced-precision reductions disabled. FP16 GEMMs accumulate FP32 where specified; FP64 used only for rank-subspace small matrix work inD3. No claimed bitwise equivalence.
current_input_reset_detail: Every class count/one-hot/moment and metric is newly derived from current train_x/train_y. Current seeds, centroids, hard-row support, weights, Gram/preconditioner and every PCG D/G slot are written before use. No persistent optimizer exists. Current test_x is copied and featurized each call. _C constants and stream/graph addresses persist, fitted values are refreshed.
stream_detail: Moments/class seeds fork after current normalized inputs and labels are ready; main joins before Fisher. LandmarkK and Woodburyfactor work on same retained side stream, which waits for each main-stream input; main joins before PCG. D3 natural-gradient side chain similarly joins before transforming features. No work escapes event/clock timing.
ownership_detail: External static clones, cached input-independent constants and streams have explicit global roots. _GRAPHS tuple retains CUDAgraph and output; captured intermediates and scratch remain in graph-private pool. There is no unrooted pre-capture Students-style owner or hidden compiler-cache dependency. gc.freeze is not relied upon to retain external fitting state.
author_evidence: All3 provided exact-source author rawrecords independently reconstruct score and optionalenergy, with three distinctUUIDs and all manifest raw hashes matching. Working filename is documented. Unsupported development counts/probabilities/timing and earlier-group histories remain separate and unverified. See author-evidence-audit.json.
